output.summary: Update the empty state on the cards page to provide information about company cards and clarify who approves new ones.
acceptance: The empty state should display a clear and concise message explaining what company cards are for.
The message should indicate that new cards can be approved by a designated person or group.
The empty state should include a call-to-action button that directs users to the appropriate settings or approval page.
The design of the empty state should remain consistent with the rest of the CardsPage component.
outOfScope: Changing the functionality of existing components
